issues.legal_issue: For income from property governed by rent-control legislation, the annual value is measured by the standard rent determinable under that legislation rather than by the higher actual rent received, even when no standard rent has been formally fixed.
material_facts: The assessee owned a warehouse subject to rent-control legislation and had let its portions to a tenant under different tenancies before entering into a lease for the entire warehouse.
For the relevant income-tax assessments, the assessee received actual rent under the lease, but no standard rent had been formally fixed for the warehouse during the periods at issue.
The tax authorities and Tribunal used the actual rent to determine annual value; a later rent-control proceeding fixed a standard rent.
issues.conclusion: The annual value had to be determined using the standard rent of the warehouse portions as determinable under the rent-control legislation, not the actual rent received. The appeals were allowed to that extent.
issues.legal_principle: Sections 22 and 23(1) of the Income-tax Act, 1961 make the annual value the amount for which property might reasonably be expected to let from year to year. Applying Dewan Daulat Rai Kapoor v. New Delhi Municipal Committee (1980), the Court held that where rent-control legislation applies, that amount cannot exceed the standard rent determinable under that legislation, even if standard rent has not been formally fixed or the time to seek its fixation has expired. The annual-value definitions in the municipal legislation considered in Dewan Daulat Rai Kapoor were materially identical to section 23(1). The standard rent was to be worked out under section 6 of the Delhi Rent Control Act, 1958; the Court also noted that the later amendment to section 23(1) supported this interpretation.

predicates.income_tax_house_property_assessment: The owner’s income from a building was being assessed under the income-tax rules for house property.
predicates.property_subject_to_rent_control: The building was governed by rent-control legislation that limited the rent reasonably recoverable for it.
predicates.standard_rent_not_formally_fixed: No authority had formally fixed the standard rent for the building during the relevant assessment period.
predicates.annual_value_is_determinable_standard_re: The building’s annual value is measured by the standard rent determinable under the rent-control rules, not by a higher actual rent received.

issues.definition: When a house-property income-tax assessment concerns a building governed by rent control and its standard rent has not been formally fixed, the annual value is measured by the determinable standard rent rather than by higher actual rent received.
